# Double-check the calculation and verify the state
import CoolProp.CoolProp as CP

# Conditions at Marianas Trench
T = 277.15  # K (4°C)
P = 108600000  # Pa (1,086 bar)

# Get density
density = CP.PropsSI('D', 'T', T, 'P', P, 'R12')
print(f"Temperature: {T} K ({T-273.15:.2f}°C)")
print(f"Pressure: {P} Pa ({P/1e5:.1f} bar)")
print(f"Density: {density:.4f} kg/m³")

# Check phase/state
phase = CP.PhaseSI('T', T, 'P', P, 'R12')
print(f"Phase: {phase}")

# Calculate volume for 0.312 kg
mass = 0.312  # kg
volume_m3 = mass / density
volume_ml = volume_m3 * 1e6
print(f"\nMass: {mass} kg")
print(f"Volume: {volume_m3:.10f} m³ = {volume_ml:.4f} mL")
print(f"Rounded to nearest mL: {round(volume_ml)}")

# Also check critical point for reference
Tc = CP.PropsSI('Tcrit', 'R12')
Pc = CP.PropsSI('Pcrit', 'R12')
rhoc = CP.PropsSI('rhocrit', 'R12')
print(f"\nCritical point:")
print(f"  Tc: {Tc} K ({Tc-273.15:.2f}°C)")
print(f"  Pc: {Pc} Pa ({Pc/1e5:.2f} bar)")
print(f"  rhoc: {rhoc} kg/m³")
